stage.quote: I believed those songs held all kinds of hidden messages meant only for me.
stage.text: I believed those songs held all kinds of hidden messages meant only for me. But all I got was the fact that Joni’s relationship with men was totally screwed up…

stage.quote: Actually, it's been over an hour.
stage.text: Max called just now. (ALAN: He did? Where?) Actually, it's been over an hour. Maybe twenty minutes. (ALAN: I don't see a phone in here.) There isn't one. He called me at home…

stage.quote: Oh, don’t slop and gush and be sentimental.
stage.text: Oh, don’t slop and gush and be sentimental. Don’t you see that unless I can be hard -- hard as nails -- I shall go mad?…

stage.quote: It's impossible; she'll cast beyond you still.
stage.text: It's impossible; she'll cast beyond you still. I'll lay my life it will never be a match. (MEL: What?) Between you and me. (MEL: Why so?) My mind gives me it won't, because we are both willing…

stage.source: The Mirror of Taste, and Dramatic Censor, Vol. I, No. 1, January 1810
stage.quote: I'm right, by all the household gods!
stage.text: I'm right, by all the household gods! 'Twas no goblin of the fen that twinkled to deceive, but a real substantial weatherproof tenement shining with invitation to benighted travellers…

stage.quote: I know we’re not even together but I see where this is going.
stage.text: We have to break up. (Beat.) Sorry. (Beat.) I know we’re not even together but I see where this is going. (Beat.) And I know we just said we love each other! I know. It was beautiful. I meant it…

stage.quote: Maxwell gets in front of her again, pushes her back.
stage.text: (mumbles) It's just my Dad. Maxwell gets in front of her again, pushes her back. (MAXWELL: What was that recruit? Speak up when you're talking to an Officer.) It's just my Dad. He raised me alone. Can I go now?…

screen.quote: Ok, should I just say it?
screen.text: Ok, should I just say it? Ok. So, I’m not a physician’s assistant – that was...anyway, I work at Abram’s Optics in the Galleria - which, if you don’t know, it’s like the worst branch there is…

screen.source: Eternal Sunshine Of The Spotless Mind
screen.quote: There’s this part where the Skin Horse tells the Rabbit what it means to be real.
screen.text: It’s my favorite book. Since I was a kid. It’s about these toys. There’s this part where the Skin Horse tells the Rabbit what it means to be real. (crying, then laughing at herself) I can’t believe I’m crying already…

screen.quote: I hate the way you talk to me and the way you cut your hair.
screen.text: I hate the way you talk to me and the way you cut your hair. I hate the way you drive my car. I hate it when you stare…

screen.quote: Of course she said that, she's fucking scared!
screen.text: Of course she said that, she's fucking scared! What the fuck do they teach you guys in grad school?…

screen.quote: I was alone in the house again.
screen.text: Okay. I had this kind of... crisis. I was alone in the house again. Lying in my bed, crying, I know, everyone lies in bed crying, but…

screen.quote: We were going to look at wedding dresses.
screen.text: We were going to look at wedding dresses. And then we weren’t. It wasn’t my fault. I wasn’t on drugs or drunk at the time. But, uh…

screen.quote: Of course not, we would just smoke pot and watch Top Gun every night until we starved to death.
screen.text: Of course not, we would just smoke pot and watch Top Gun every night until we starved to death. You aren’t a kid anymore. But he is. And you aren’t doing him any favors…
